title: Resolution calling on the New York State Assembly to pass, and for the Governor to sign, A.9646A, whose companion bill S.9113A, has already been passed by the New York State Senate, to establish an insurance risk pool ensuring foster care agencies can obtain the required liability insurance to provide assistance with rapidly rising insurance costs, and, to update the State reimbursement rates to better reflect current insurance expenses, and to create the voluntary foster care agency insurance bridge fund
